module_summary: Direct-mapped cache line bank: per-line tag, data and valid arrays indexed by slot; tag compare yields hit, fill refills a line, poke updates its data.

anchors.name: keys_flat
anchors.why: Tag array, one key per line, written on fill and compared for hit.

anchors.name: vals_flat
anchors.why: Data array, written on fill or poke, read out as q.

anchors.name: live
anchors.why: Per-line valid bits set on fill, qualify the hit.

anchors.name: slot
anchors.why: Line index selecting tag/data/valid entry for lookup and writes.

anchors.name: key
anchors.why: Lookup tag compared against stored key; stored on fill.

anchors.name: fill
anchors.why: Refill enable: writes tag, data and sets valid for slot.

anchors.name: poke
anchors.why: Data-only write enable updating selected line value.

anchors.name: fill_val
anchors.why: Refill data written into data array.

anchors.name: poke_val
anchors.why: Write data for poke updates of a line.

anchors.name: match
anchors.why: Hit output: valid bit and tag equality for indexed line.

groups.name: tag_valid_array
groups.description: Tag and valid arrays with comparator producing hit.

groups.name: data_array
groups.description: Line data storage written by fill or poke, read by slot.

groups.name: write_control
groups.description: Slot index decode with fill/poke enables per line.
